scope: Two on-screen controls: left movement; right aim and automatic fire beyond dead zone. No buttons or extra HUD.

implementation.desktop: WASD/arrows move; hold mouse button or Space to aim/fire at cursor; each visible stick also accepts a mouse drag. Mouse firing is suppressed while touch input is active and on mobile platforms.
implementation.layout: Screen.safeArea corners; tracks safe-area, resolution and orientation, including 180 degree landscape flip. Cancels old contacts on layout change.
implementation.cancellation: CancellationVersion increments for app focus/pause, timeScale zero, disable/enable, respawn cancellation, screen layout change, OS cancelled/lost/invalid contacts. Gameplay consumers must discard queued shots on version changes. Ordinary release does not increment: queued short taps remain valid.
implementation.resume: CancelUntilRelease clears outputs and waits for all fingers, mouse/Space and movement keys to release before controls resume.
implementation.rendering: Two cached procedural 128x128 textures, OnGUI Repaint only; no Canvas/EventSystem/UGUI dependency.

pointer_state.method: Production IntercomTwinStickState.cs compiled with Roslyn from .NET SDK 8.0.427 and executed on .NET 8.

syntax.method: C#9 syntax parse under Legacy, Input System, and neither-input defines; not Unity assembly/type compilation.

not_executed: Physical Android/iOS multi-touch and safe-area testing
manual_acceptance: Use two thumbs at once; move and turn/fire independently. Crossing fingers or adding a third finger must not swap ownership.
Move the right stick inside the dead zone: no fire. Move outside: turn and fire. Recenter or release: stop auto-fire; a brief intentional tap may finish raising arms and fire one queued shot.
While raising arms, rotate phone, switch apps, pause or force an OS touch cancel: no old queued shot may fire after resume. Release both fingers and press anew.
Rotate between both landscape orientations; controls stay within the notch/home-indicator safe area. Resizing Game view must clear old contacts.
Release only left thumb: aiming/firing continues. Release only right thumb: movement continues.
On desktop use WASD plus mouse outside stick regions; clicking/dragging the left stick must never fire. Reset while firing and hold controls: firing cannot resume until all inputs release.
